svg.title: astop monitoring eight Ascend 910B4-1 NPUs
svg.desc: Terminal preview rendered from a live astop -P session. Eight compact NPU cards each use two metadata lines and one utilization and HBM bar line. The metadata shows identity, PCIe generation and traffic, temperature, power, ECC errors, and HCCS health and traffic. Eight live history graphs appear below. The process list is hidden.
